Learn a shared feature representation across output classes instead of independent coefficients, within unchanged deployment caps. More training epochs are accounted, not hidden as a free comparison.
selection: Exact complete dev structures, then fewer scalar coefficients, then policy order. No full M1 approval from this selection.
scope: Experiments only, under the same 196608-byte page and 262144-byte genome/residency caps. Margin is a milli-logit difference, not probability or action authority. Full M1 gates unchanged, no M2, no operational promotion. Unknown RSS/energy remain unavailable.
